'''Maria-Magdalena Zaharescu''' (born 1938) is a [[Romania]]n chemist, specializing in the [[physical chemistry]] of oxide systems.<ref>Dictionarul "Membrii Academiei Române 1866-2010", Editura Enciclopedică, 2010, p. 1142.</ref>

Zaharescu was a Senior Researcher and Head of Department at the Ilie Murgulescu Institute of Physical Chemistry of the [[Romanian Academy]] in [[Bucharest]].<ref>Institute of Physical Chemistry - Research team staff http://www.icf.ro/L7.htm#staff {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402113853/http://www.icf.ro/L7.htm#staff |date=2 April 2015 }}; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref><ref>Institute of Physical Chemistry - Laboratory of oxide materials science http://icf.getion.ro/ ; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref><ref>Second Nanoforum Report: Technology in the Candidate Countries, March 2004, page 187; {{cite web|url=http://www.nanoforum.org/dateien/temp/Nanotechnology%20in%20the%20Candidate%20Countries.pdf |title=Archived copy |accessdate=2013-02-02 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20040118024428/http://www.nanoforum.org/dateien/temp/Nanotechnology%20in%20the%20Candidate%20Countries.pdf |archivedate=2004-01-18 }}; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref> In 2001, she was elected a corresponding member of the Romanian Academy and became a [[List of members of the Romanian Academy|full member]] in June 2015.<ref>Chemical Sciences Section of the Romanian Academy http://www.acad.ro/sectii/sectia05_chimie/chim_membri.htm; retrieved on June 23, 2015</ref> On December 1, 2017, she was awarded a Knight of the [[Order of the Star of Romania]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.agerpres.ro/politica/2017/12/01/iohannis-a-decorat-personalitati-din-domeniul-medical-si-al-cercetarii-18-20-54; |title=Archived copy |access-date=2 December 2017 |archive-date=2 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171202203142/https://www.agerpres.ro/politica/2017/12/01/iohannis-a-decorat-personalitati-din-domeniul-medical-si-al-cercetarii-18-20-54; |url-status=dead }}</ref>

She was one of the 100 women scientists featured in "Successful Women Ceramic and Glass Scientists and Engineers: 100 Inspirational Profiles" <ref>Madsen, Lynnette: Successful Women Ceramic and Glass Scientists and Engineers: 100 Inspirational Profiles - http://www.wiley.com/WileyCDA/WileyTitle/productCd-1118733606.html; retrieved on March 20, 2016</ref>  by Lynnette Madsen (2016).

== Scientific interests ==

Her scientific interests include:<ref>Jury composition for the "Women in Science" Unesco - L'Oreal Award, 3rd edition, Romania, 2012; http://www.cnr-unesco.ro/ro/Prezentare%20juriu%202012.pdf {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130108030312/http://www.cnr-unesco.ro/ro/Prezentare%20juriu%202012.pdf |date=8 January 2013 }}; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref>

* Physical chemistry of oxide systems (reactions mechanisms, thermal phase equilibria, structure-properties correlations).
* [[Sol-gel]] science (sol-gel chemistry, nanostructured oxide films and powders, inorganic-organic hybrids, [[nanocomposites]], oxide nanotubes). She introduced and developed the field of sol-gel research in Romania.<ref>Interview in Romanian newspaper "[[Curentul]]", Nr 159(3832), Friday, August 10, 2007; {{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130416133912/http://arhiva.curentul.ro:81/2007old/curentul.php?numar=20070810&art=59826}}; retrieved on February 23, 2013</ref>
* Vitreous oxide systems with special properties (thermally and chemically stable)

== Education ==
She graduated from the [[Babeș-Bolyai University]], Faculty of Chemistry, and received her PhD from the Institute of Chemistry, both in [[Cluj-Napoca]].

retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref> ''[[Journal of the European Ceramic Society]]''; ''[[Journal of the American Ceramic Society]]''; ''[[Journal of Materials Chemistry]]''; ''[[Journal of Materials Science]]''; ''[[Journal of Materials Research]]''; ''[[Materials Chemistry and Physics]]''; ''[[Journal of Non-Crystalline Solids]]''; ''[[Journal of Thermal Analysis and Calorimetry]]''; ''[[Applied Surface Science]]''; ''[[Journal of Nanoparticle Research]]''; ''[[Ceramics International]]''; ''[[Thin Solid Films]]''; ''[[Revue Roumaine de Chimie]]'', etc. as well as 3 patents and 8 book chapters edited by the Romanian Academy and international publishers.<ref>Publications list on researchgate.com https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Maria_Zaharescu/; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref><ref>List of publications {{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130410043055/http://libra.msra.cn/PublicationList?srcType=8&desType=2&srcID=41892&desID=13384912}}; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref>
*In 2016, Zaharescu published 1D Oxide Nanostructures Obtained by Sol-Gel and Hydrothermal Methods,<ref>{{cite book |url=https://www.amazon.com/Nanostructures-Obtained-Hydrothermal-SpringerBriefs-Materials-ebook/dp/B01LAE1EK4/ref=mt_kindle?_encoding=UTF8&me=; |title=1D Oxide Nanostructures Obtained by Sol-Gel and Hydrothermal Methods |via=www.amazon.com |date= 30 August 2016|publisher=Springer |access-date=December 2, 2017}}</ref> as part of the SpringerBriefs<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.springer.com/gp/authors-editors/book-authors-editors/springerbriefs; |title=SpringerBriefs |website=www.springer.com |access-date=December 2, 2017}}</ref> series offered by the [[Springer Publishing]] Company.
* International research projects in collaboration with Davis University, USA (funded by NST-USA), [[National Technical University of Athens]],  [[Greece]] (funded by NATO) and [[universities]] from [[Czech Republic]], [[Bulgaria]], [[France]], [[Slovenia]]

* Member of the [[American Ceramic Society]] – Basic Research Division
* Member of the American Nano Society
* Member of the editorial board of the ''[[Journal of Sol-Gel Science and Technology]]''.<ref>Composition of the editorial board of the Journal of Sol-Gel Science and Technology; https://www.springer.com/materials/special+types/journal/10971?detailsPage=editorialBoard {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160722045239/http://www.springer.com/materials/special%20types/journal/10971?detailsPage=editorialBoard |date=22 July 2016 }}; retrieved on February 23, 2013</ref>

== Awards ==
*1971 - Gheorghe Spacu Award, Romanian Academy
*1982 - Scientific Merit Medal, Romania
*1983 - Scientific Order Third Degree, Romania
*2007 - Honor Award and [http://www.schr.org.ro/premii%20si%20distinctii.php Gheorghe Spacu Medal], Romanian Society of Chemistry<ref>Romanian Chemistry Society Bulletin 1/2011, page 32; http://www.schr.org.ro/doc/Buletinul%20Societatii%20de%20Chimie%20din%20ROMANIA%20-%20Nr.%20XVIII%20-%201,2011.pdf; retrieved on February 10, 2013</ref>
*2017 - Knight of the [[Order of the Star of Romania]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://125.agerpres.ro/politica/2017/12/01/iohannis-a-decorat-personalitati-din-domeniul-medical-si-al-cercetarii-18-20-54; |title=Wayback Machine has not archived that URL. |website=125.agerpres.ro |access-date=December 2, 2017}}{{Dead link|date=September 2023}}</ref>
